mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier_score (score_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, evaluation_count, scored_at) VALUES (#{scoreId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{qualityScore}, #{deliveryScore}, #{priceScore}, #{serviceScore}, #{overallScore}, #{evaluationCount}, #{scoredAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_supplier_score SET quality_score = #{qualityScore}, delivery_score = #{deliveryScore}, price_score = #{priceScore}, service_score = #{serviceScore}, overall_score = #{overallScore}, evaluation_count = #{evaluationCount}, scored_at = #{scoredAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: SELECT score_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, quality_score, delivery_score, price_score, service_score, overall_score, evaluation_count, scored_at FROM scm_supplier_score WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
